Card Q&A.q: During my opponent's turn, a Digimon with this digivolution card is deleted, and this card's inherited effect moves the memory gauge to 1 on my side. Is it now my turn?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it does. Turns only switch after all attacks and effects activate and finish, so it becomes your turn after the  check is performed and the attack finishes.
